text: Fixed. `robust` default changed FALSE -> NULL in both S3 methods so unspecified is distinguishable from explicitly-off; .fmri_lm_normalize_robust_options now collects requests from robust / robust_psi / robust_options$type and errors on genuine disagreement. Verified: robust_psi='bisquare' alone -> type=bisquare. test_robust_args.R rewritten - it previously asserted only expect_error(...,NA) on a self-contradictory call (robust=TRUE + robust_psi='bisquare') and passed regardless; it now asserts the executed config.
